name: Mechiku ~Injoku no Shuuyoujo~
source:
Public prisons are overcrowded, so private prisons are called to answer this challenge. There is a new type of prison with a 0% recidivism rate - none of its visitors ever harm society again. It's a concentration camp on an isolated island where prisoners have no rights but to obediently follow any director orders. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
